notes: Godot 4.7 released word/crossword game (trampoline 4.1.0) by Michel Cheenne and Maximilien Naveau, with F-Droid/web/desktop builds. Original ImageMagick/SVG art and custom desktop/app icons (desktop_icon.png md5 0b6f8c37485a18503ee19ad660d6c573). Caveat and Jost variable fonts under SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL text files bundled). French dictionary (Dicollecte Classique, Olivier R.) under MPL-2.0, documented in NOTICE. Audio instrument samples are not in the repository (fetched at build time). No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp, no default Godot icon. src/keys/debug.keystore (documented public Android debug signing key) was omitted.
